name: Testing Conventions (willfire)

# A second call over the absorbed package: `source` derives the package root, so
# the gates read `packages/willfire/package.json` and its `e2e-attestations/`.
#
# `gates` allowlists every gate except `unit-coverage` (willfire enforces no
# coverage floor), and `packaging` and `changelog` (willfire is private and no
# longer published).

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'packages/willfire/**'
      - '!packages/willfire/*.md'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-willfire.yml'
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'packages/willfire/**'
      - '!packages/willfire/*.md'
      - 'package.json'
      - 'pnpm-lock.yaml'
      - 'pnpm-workspace.yaml'
      - '.github/workflows/conventions-willfire.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  conventions:
    uses: thekevinscott/testing-conventions/.github/workflows/testing-conventions.yml@v0
    with:
      languages: '["typescript"]'
      source: packages/willfire/src
      gates: >-
        ["colocated-test", "one-function-per-file", "unit-lint",
        "integration-lint", "e2e-verify", "mutation"]

name: Promote v1 tag

on:
  workflow_run:
    # Every workflow that runs on push to `main` belongs here, or `v1` never advances.
    workflows:
      - Tests
      - Testing Conventions
    types: [completed]

permissions:
  contents: write
  actions: read

concurrency:
  group: promote-v1
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  promote:
    name: Promote v1
    if: >-
      github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
      github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - name: Promote v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          PROMOTE_OWNER: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          PROMOTE_REPO: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          PROMOTE_SHA: ${{ github.event.workflow_run.head_sha }}
          PROMOTE_TAG: v1
        run: pnpm run promote

name: PR Monitor

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]
    branches:
      - main

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  actions: read
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read

jobs:
  monitor:
    name: 'CI Gate'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # The action has no timeout of its own; this is the backstop.
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: ./

    branches: [main]

      - 'src/**'

jobs:
  typecheck:
    name: Typecheck
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run typecheck

  lint:
    name: Lint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run lint

  test:
    name: Test (100% coverage)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      - uses: pnpm/action-setup@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v7
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          cache: pnpm
      - run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - run: pnpm run test:coverage

  actionlint:
    name: Actionlint
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v7
      # Pinned release + checksum: a `uses:` on a former owner name runs whoever claims it next.
      - name: Install actionlint
        env:
          VERSION: 1.7.12
          SHA256: 8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8
        run: |
          curl -fsSL -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v$VERSION/actionlint_${VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          echo "$SHA256  $RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint.tar.gz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP" actionlint
      - name: Lint workflows
        run: |
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/actionlint" -color
